title: When the Postcard Turns
author: Odile Thornbury
blurb: Bram Amberdale, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
